preset.title: Preset employer list
preset.description: A curated list of hardware-heavy employers whose public job boards answered when last checked. Combine with your own boards below.

companies.title: Job boards
companies.description: Boards to read, one per line: greenhouse:TOKEN, lever:SITE, ashby:BOARD, or a public board URL such as https://boards.greenhouse.io/acme, https://jobs.lever.co/acme or https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/acme. Lever site names are case-sensitive.

keywords.title: Keywords (optional)
keywords.description: Keep postings whose title or description contains at least one of these words (case-insensitive).

internshipOnly.title: Internships and co-ops only
internshipOnly.description: Keep only postings detected as internships, co-ops or student roles.

hardwareOnly.title: Hardware roles only
hardwareOnly.description: Keep only postings scored as hardware/EE work (embedded, FPGA/ASIC, analog, RF, power, PCB, test, controls, semiconductor process, photonics).

disciplines.title: Disciplines (optional)
disciplines.description: Keep postings tagged with any of these hardware disciplines.

classYear.title: Class-year signal
classYear.description: Filter on the class-year label. fs = the posting says first-year, sophomore or rising-junior students can apply, or gives a freshman/sophomore graduation year; jplus = junior/senior standing, an earlier graduation date or a graduate degree; open = everything except jplus, including postings that state no class year (the most common case). Any keeps every posting.

excludeRestricted.title: Exclude citizenship, export-control and clearance flags
excludeRestricted.description: Drop postings whose text mentions US citizenship, US person/permanent residency, ITAR/EAR export control or a security clearance.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Stop after this many dataset items.

includeSnippet.title: Include label evidence
includeSnippet.description: Add up to 300 characters from the posting that explain the class-year and flag labels. Full descriptions are never stored.

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between boards
requestDelayMs.description: Pause between board requests. Keep it polite.
